versions.content: The job of the function NvM_WriteBlock shall provide the possibility t o copy a temporary RAM block to a NV block although the NVRAM block is configured with a permanent RAM block or explicit synchronization callbacks. In this case, the parameter NvM_SrcPtr must be unequal to a NULL pointer. Otherwise a DET - Parameter error (s ee Section 7.4 ) shall be emitted
